_note: Cranky Chickens VII — We Know You're Here. Kid contributions from the Cannon Master and Dragon Scribe portals land here via Mission Control. Zones mirror the real screen grid in games/cc7.html: screenIndex maps to (sx,sy) as index = sy*3 + sx.

zones.name: The Garden Gate
zones.note: Where you arrive. Two flowers, a gentle climb.

zones.name: The Long Drop
zones.note: The pit here falls through to The Climb below.

zones.name: The Far Corner
zones.note: Dead end to the east. Nothing beyond. Yet.

zones.name: The Quiet Bed
zones.note: A side pocket. Easy to miss.

zones.name: The Climb
zones.note: The way back up. Platform alignment here is load-bearing.

zones.name: Where It Watches
zones.note: The quietest screen. Named by the chickens, not by us.

chickenLines.speaker: SCRATCHY
chickenLines.text: I hate that the blocks fall down on you in Mystery Island.

chickenLines.speaker: PEARL
chickenLines.text: The garden should have a place where nothing can reach you.

_kidContributions._note: Dialogue written by the Dragon Scribe and characters drawn by the Cannon Master. Lines added to chickenLines are read by the Chorus in games/cc7.html.
